data=open('/app/trunc.db','rb').read()
import struct
ptype=data[0]
freeblock=struct.unpack('>H',data[1:3])[0]
ncells=struct.unpack('>H',data[3:5])[0]
cstart=struct.unpack('>H',data[5:7])[0]
frag=data[7]
print(ptype,freeblock,ncells,cstart,frag)
ptr_off=8
ptrs=[struct.unpack('>H',data[ptr_off+2*i:ptr_off+2*i+2])[0] for i in range(ncells)]
print(ptrs)

def varint(buf,pos):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        b=buf[pos+i]
        if i==8:
            v=(v<<8)|b
            return v,pos+9
        v=(v<<7)|(b&0x7f)
        if not b&0x80:
            return v,pos+i+1

for i,p in enumerate(ptrs):
    plen,pos=varint(data,p)
    rowid,pos=varint(data,pos)
    payload=data[pos:pos+plen]
    print(f"--- cell {i} ptr={p} plen={plen} rowid={rowid} pos={pos} payload={payload!r}")
    # parse record header
    hlen,hp=varint(payload,0)
    print("   header len",hlen)
    types=[]

    while q<hlen:
        st,q=varint(payload,q)
        types.append(st)
    print("   serial types",types)

    off=hlen

    for st in types:
        if st==0: vals.append(None)
        elif st==1: vals.append(struct.unpack('>b',payload[off:off+1])[0]); off+=1
        elif st==2: vals.append(struct.unpack('>h',payload[off:off+2])[0]); off+=2
        elif st==3: vals.append(int.from_bytes(payload[off:off+3],'big',signed=True)); off+=3
        elif st==4: vals.append(struct.unpack('>i',payload[off:off+4])[0]); off+=4
        elif st==5: vals.append(int.from_bytes(payload[off:off+6],'big',signed=True)); off+=6
        elif st==6: vals.append(int.from_bytes(payload[off:off+8],'big',signed=True)); off+=8
        elif st==7: vals.append(struct.unpack('>d',payload[off:off+8])[0]); off+=8
        elif st==8: vals.append(0)
        elif st==9: vals.append(1)
        elif st>=12 and st%2==0:
            n=(st-12)//2

python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, struct
data=open('/app/trunc.db','rb').read()
ncells=struct.unpack('>H',data[3:5])[0]
ptrs=[struct.unpack('>H',data[8+2*i:10+2*i])[0] for i in range(ncells)]
def varint(buf,pos):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        b=buf[pos+i]
        if i==8: return (v<<8)|b,pos+9
        v=(v<<7)|(b&0x7f)
        if not b&0x80: return v,pos+i+1
def decode(payload):
    hlen,hp=varint(payload,0); types=[]; q=hp
    while q<hlen:
        st,q=varint(payload,q); types.append(st)
    off=hlen; vals=[]
    for st in types:
        if st==0: vals.append(None)
        elif st==1: vals.append(struct.unpack('>b',payload[off:off+1])[0]); off+=1
        elif st==2: vals.append(struct.unpack('>h',payload[off:off+2])[0]); off+=2
        elif st==3: vals.append(int.from_bytes(payload[off:off+3],'big',signed=True)); off+=3
        elif st==4: vals.append(struct.unpack('>i',payload[off:off+4])[0]); off+=4
        elif st==5: vals.append(int.from_bytes(payload[off:off+6],'big',signed=True)); off+=6
        elif st==6: vals.append(int.from_bytes(payload[off:off+8],'big',signed=True)); off+=8
        elif st==7: vals.append(struct.unpack('>d',payload[off:off+8])[0]); off+=8
        elif st==8: vals.append(0)
        elif st==9: vals.append(1)
        elif st>=12 and st%2==0:
            n=(st-12)//2; vals.append(payload[off:off+n].decode()); off+=n
        elif st>=13 and st%2==1:
            n=(st-13)//2; vals.append(payload[off:off+n].decode()); off+=n
    return vals
rows=[]
for p in ptrs:
    plen,pos=varint(data,p); rowid,pos=varint(data,pos)
    vals=decode(data[pos:pos+plen])
    rows.append({"word":vals[1],"value":vals[2]})
rows.sort(key=lambda r:r["word"])
open('/app/recover.json','w').write(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
